goldens.comment: Incorrect end time calculation using slotStartTime instead of slotEndTime
goldens.reasoning: C1 points out that slotStartTime is used where slotEndTime should be, which is the same end-time bug.

goldens.comment: Using === for dayjs object comparison will always return false as it compares object references, not values. Use .isSame() method instead: dayjs(date.start).add(utcOffset, 'minutes').isSame(dayjs(date.end).add(utcOffset, minutes))
goldens.reasoning: C2 points out that comparing Dayjs objects with === fails and that .isSame() should be used instead.

candidates: Line 147 uses slotStartTime for both start and end instead of slotEndTime, ignoring event length in working hours boundary check
Line 114 compares Dayjs objects with === which always returns false - should use .isSame() for Dayjs comparison

Lines 102-140: .find() returns on first override that doesn't contain the slot, causing false rejection even if another override on the same day does - should use .filter() to collect all overrides for the day, then .some() to check if any contain the slot
Line 212 uses override.timeZone which is optional - if undefined, dayjs may default to local TZ and mis-shift overrides. Should add fallback and avoid toString() parsing
